title: docs(deployment): name the /meta/diagnostics query refusals and the canonical stats key
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Refs #27632 (the #27620 half: the three value refusals and the canonical `stats` key; the #27913 parameter-name refusal stays on the card until #27913 lands)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`validating-metadata.mdx` 的 `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` 参数表补上三种 400 拒收(未知 `type`、`severity`、`package`),并说明 `stats` 按规范类型名作键。
- 为什么改:#27620 之后该路由已拒收这三类错误值，文档没写，读文档的 AI 和 CI 作者仍以为拼错会得到空的「全部通过」。
- 风险与回滚：仅文档，一个文件、一节;回滚即 revert 本 PR,不影响任何发布包。
- 先看:`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` 的 diagnostics 一节(参数表与其后两段)。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`,预期只见该节的表格加一列、两段新文字。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The `GET /api/v1/meta/diagnostics` section of `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` now states what the route does since #27620, each sentence written from the code on `origin/main` (`ed0e71db94`):

- The query table gains a column naming each parameter's `400 INVALID_REQUEST` refusal:
  - `severity`: any value other than `error` / `warning` (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`, the severity check).
  - `type`: a misspelling of a declared type, whose message names the accepted spellings (`canonicalizeMetaRequestType` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), or a name that is neither a declared type nor in the deployment's live type set (`refuseUnknownMetaListType` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`). A live type outside the static contract still answers 200.
  - `package`: a package that is not installed and that no swept item is bound to (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`). An installed package with no items answers zero counts. `all` sweeps every package (`metaItemPackageBinding`).
- An empty value keeps the default. Every refusal uses the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` envelope, and a repeated parameter answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` in the same envelope (`refuseRepeatedQueryParams`).
- `stats` and each entry's `type` use the canonical type name, so `type=views` answers under `stats.view`, the same as `type=view` (`canonicalMetaUrlType` in the sweep).
- The CI-gate sentence now says that a misspelled `type` or `package` answers the 400 rather than an empty sweep.

Left out: the refusal of an unknown query parameter NAME (#27633 / PR #27913). That PR was still open on `origin/main` `ed0e71db94` when this branch was cut. Card comment 6514340216 carries the text to add once it lands.

## Tests

Docs only, so there is no test to run. The route's own pins in `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts` (unchanged) back each documented clause: the three refusals, the near-miss message naming `'view'`, the repeated-parameter `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the canonical `stats.view` for `type=views`, and the preservation cases (empty severity, `package=all`, an installed package with no items, items bound to an uninstalled package, a live type outside the static contract).

## Acceptance notes

- No finding filed.

- Each command's exit code was written to disk before any pipe. On the first pass, four gates refused with exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and client dist): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples` and `check:docs-transcript-drift`. After `turbo run build` of those closures under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0, 38/38 tasks), all four re-ran with exit 0.
- `check:doc-authoring`: exit 0 ("70 published skill files clean", "19837 customer-facing string(s) ... clean").
- `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran` (each line recorded with its exit code) answered "43 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 43 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
